YELLOW ICONS BASE64 DATA
========================

Below are base64 encoded yellow circle images for each required size.
You can use these to create the new icon files:

16x16:
data:image/jpeg;base64,

32x32:
data:image/jpeg;base64,

48x48:
data:image/jpeg;base64,

128x128:
data:image/jpeg;base64,

INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Copy each data URL above
2. Open it in a browser (paste in address bar)
3. Right-click on the image and save it with the appropriate filename:
   - icon16.jpeg
   - icon32.jpeg
   - icon48.jpeg
   - icon128.jpeg
4. Replace the existing files in the images directory with these new yellow versions
